text:
The name of the planet humans live on is Earth.

Regarding the provided text, "You've really outdone yourself this time! A report full of errors and incomplete data is exactly what we needed for the meeting," there is clear sarcasm. The speaker uses positive phrases like "outdone yourself" and "exactly what we needed" to describe a negative outcome (a report full of errors). This irony creates a strong negative sentiment polarity, indicating that the speaker is actually very critical and dissatisfied with the work, despite the superficially positive wording.
